ModMetaData.name: Cheat Genes By Lilly
ModMetaData.author: Lilly
ModMetaData.description:
Cheat Genes adds around 275 overpowered genes for building custom xenotypes and xenogerms in the gene editor. Everything is optional, and every gene is sorted into a category starting with "Cheat:" so it is easy to find.
WHAT'S INCLUDED - Presets: Speedster, Strongman, Invulnerable, God, Super-Duper Psychic, Technomancer and Kraltech, with extra effects when Odyssey, Anomaly, Ideology, Kraltech or Vanilla Psycasts Expanded are loaded. - Gene Points: genes that give complexity, metabolism and archite room for your builds. - Yields & Harvest: meat, leather, mining, plant harvest, drug harvest, animal gather, fishing and butchery, each in 2x, 3x, 4x and 10x tiers (one tier per stat). - Single-stat genes, grouped into Work Speed, Movement & Carrying, Combat, Health & Survival, Mind & Social, Animals & Hunting, and Psychic, Mech & Anomaly. - Disable Needs and Immunities (diseases and injuries). - Modded Stats: Kraltech and Vanilla Expanded genes that only appear when that mod is loaded. Labels show the real value, for example "Move Speed +9", which most stats display in-game as +900%.
REQUIREMENTS - Biotech. - Supports RimWorld 1.4 to 1.7. - Genes that use Royalty, Ideology, Anomaly, Odyssey or other mod content only load when that content is active.
KNOWN ISSUES - Technomancer: only add it after the pawn is a mechanitor with the mech upgrade chips, or the game can freeze. - God and Super-Duper Psychic have huge psychic sensitivity, so psychic mood penalties are huge. Both also get a very low mental break threshold so those pawns do not snap. - Cheat yields can flood the map with items. Use the lower tiers if performance suffers.
CREDITS Based on Cheat Genes by antisocialian. Updated for 1.7, reorganized and expanded by dunforgor.
